bc-trade-development-corporation.ministry: Ministry of International Business and Immigration
bc-trade-development-corporation.note: BC Trade's July 1989 launch advertisement places it under the Ministry of International Business and Immigration, with the minister, John Jansen, as its chairman; Jansen introduced its Act in March 1989. When the responsibility moved is not established (Premier Harcourt later kept responsibility for the corporation, without a recorded portfolio title).
